readinessTiers.description: Student possesses strong core technical competencies, verified portfolio projects, and meets entry to mid-level industry hiring standards.
readinessTiers.recommendedAction: Begin actively applying for full-time job openings, mock technical interviews, and networking on LinkedIn.

readinessTiers.description: Solid foundational knowledge established. Needs 1-2 major capstone projects and deeper framework specialization to bridge the gap.
readinessTiers.recommendedAction: Focus on Phase 2 & Phase 3 roadmap tasks, complete 1 full-stack project, and pursue 1 industry certification.

readinessTiers.description: Early stage learning. High skill gap present in core algorithms, tools, or hands-on practice.
readinessTiers.recommendedAction: Dedicate 15+ hours per week to Phase 1 foundational courses, coding exercises, and basic Git version control.

interviewReadinessChecklist.title: ATS-Optimized Resume
interviewReadinessChecklist.description: Quantified achievement bullets (e.g., 'Optimized API response time by 40%') tailored to target job title.

interviewReadinessChecklist.title: Public GitHub Portfolio
interviewReadinessChecklist.description: At least 2 well-documented repositories with clean README files, architecture diagrams, and live demo links.

interviewReadinessChecklist.title: Data Structures & Algorithmic Problem Solving
interviewReadinessChecklist.description: Ability to solve Medium difficulty LeetCode / HackerRank problems in arrays, trees, dynamic programming, and graphs.

interviewReadinessChecklist.title: Behavioral STAR Method Preparation
interviewReadinessChecklist.description: Prepared responses for Situation, Task, Action, and Result covering teamwork, conflict resolution, and technical challenges.
